segments.text: What if Goku joined the Avengers? Earth's insurance company is cooked.
segments.label: EARTH IS FINANCIALLY COOKED

segments.text: Tony sees the hair and asks, is that in the dress code?
segments.label: THE DRESS CODE

segments.text: Brother, your team hired a green rage fridge. Relax.
segments.label: THE GREEN RAGE FRIDGE

segments.text: In this crossover, Thor calls himself a god. Goku hears free training partner.
segments.label: FREE TRAINING PARTNER

segments.text: Congratulations. The welcome party now needs a demolition permit.
segments.label: THE WELCOME PARTY

segments.text: Captain America says they need a plan.
segments.label: CAPTAIN HAS A PLAN

segments.text: My guy, this man thinks strategy means screaming until his hair updates.
segments.label: SCREAMING IS NOT A STRATEGY

segments.text: Then they order lunch. Motherflicker, they need a second budget.
segments.label: LUNCH REQUIRES FUNDING

segments.text: Goku calls it a snack. Tony calls his accountant.
segments.label: CALL THE ACCOUNTANT

segments.text: Thanos starts the usual galaxy speech.
segments.label: HERE COMES THE SPEECH

segments.text: Goku asks, are you strong, or just purple and unemployed?
segments.label: PURPLE AND UNEMPLOYED

segments.text: All that villain aura. Suddenly he is getting checked like carry on luggage.
segments.label: AURA MEETS AIRPORT SECURITY

segments.text: But Goku gives the bad guy a chance to power up.
segments.label: HE LETS THE VILLAIN POWER UP

segments.text: Oh, fantastic. Our emergency has a premium subscription.
segments.label: PREMIUM EMERGENCY

segments.text: The Avengers are begging him to finish the fight.
segments.label: PLEASE FINISH THE FIGHT

segments.text: He wants a rematch. This walking side quest needs adult supervision.
segments.label: WALKING SIDE QUEST

segments.text: Still, they would want him protecting Earth.
segments.label: EARTH STILL NEEDS A HERO

segments.text: Just keep him away from mission planning and the grocery card.
segments.label: CONFISCATE THE GROCERY CARD

segments.text: Would he save the team, or bankrupt it before the next invasion?
segments.label: SAVE THE TEAM OR BANKRUPT IT
